exposure: Maternal vitamin D levels in early pregnancy
Women with and without vitamin D deficiency
outcome: Emergency cesarean section due to suspected fetal distress
finding: Low maternal vitamin D levels in early pregnancy were associated with emergency cesarean section due to suspected fetal distress and birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: This study found an association between low maternal vitamin D levels in early pregnancy and emergency cesarean sections due to suspected fetal distress.
